author: ClubberNugget
body:
Ok, so i'm seeing that some maps are getting overplayed and people are getting sick of them, ie: Blue Cove, Tetris Jungle, WIld West.  And other maps that rarely ever get played, ie: Vanilla, Tetris Winter, Lost Island.

The reason being, Blue cove, tetris jungle and wild west, are all at the front of the rot and the other ones i mentioned, are at the end of the rot, plus, only two servers are playing regular walls maps. Groups of players never make it to the end of the rot due to people leaving after getting killed and people not wanting to wait for the next round and then, there is never enough players.  

So my suggestion is that once a server ends its rot, when it restarts, it randomly generates a new rotation, a completely new one, with 8 or so maps randomly placed in an order.  so then all the maps can share the love and no maps get overplayed.  I do not know if this is possible or if anything similiar is even possible but if possible, i think that would be a great way to get all the maps equal playtime.

Thoughts?
